snippet.title: Friendslop heisting Indie game Burgle Supply Company, Release Date Announcement Trailer!
snippet.description:
We're launching our burgle-with-friends coop multiplayer indiegame Burgle Supply Company next month. In it you join up with friends, explore a strange town, steal everything not bolted down in wacky physics-based levels, run away from monstrous pets, grow your reputation and improve your headquarters, and, if you are good enough, become the Master Burglar!
Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3670740/Burgle_Supply_Company/?curator_clanid=33210920
